en.html:
Ichijou spat, making no effort to conceal the act. Her interpretation was understandable. A man hides behind a tree and watches in silence. Fear has nailed his feet there—that is what people will ordinarily think.

In terms of actual activity, there was no difference. Stand and watch: I had done exactly that. On what basis could I object to her opinion? Having let somebody face danger without intervening, an apology was due from me. I bowed solemnly.

en.html:
Only after the explanation did it occur to me: fortunate that we were in a forest.

This could be taken as criticism of the government. To put it mildly, protection of human rights was not the Rokuhara shogunate's principal occupation.

Say such things loudly in town and the shogunate's ears—posted everywhere, violating precisely the privacy being discussed—might hear. Then arrest. Plenty of examples already existed. And not only the speaker; whoever heard the speech could be dragged in also. Some care was required.

The girl before me did not seem concerned about that. She stared as though she had bitten an unripe persimmon.

en.html:
Kageaki"Proceed straight in this direction. The village is there."
Ichijou"H-haan."
Kageaki"Understand this clearly. Straight. Without deviation."
Ichijou"Samajh gayi, yaar... Except around trees. I'll turn to avoid a tree. That much is allowed, no?"
Kageaki"Not allowed."
Ichijou"NOT ALLOWED!?"
Kageaki"For an artistic person of your caliber, that much is sufficient to become lost."
Ichijou"ART BAND KAR! Stop this art business! What do you WANT me to do!?"
Kageaki"If possible, jump over the trees."
Ichijou"POSSIBLE KAHAN HAI!? It's a TREE!"
Kageaki"Then an aggressive policy. Smash whatever trees obstruct you and proceed straight."
Ichijou"Brown bear samajh rakha hai!? And that's DEFORESTATION! Forget all this chutiyapa. I go... there. Straight over THERE. No getting lost!"
Kageaki"Your 'there' is already off by just under thirty degrees. I cannot find the reassurance in it."
Ichijou"...S-small misunderstanding. Bas."
Kageaki"You cannot manage it."
Ichijou"Don't say it so quietly! With that FACE! Enough, I'm going. Fine. Thanks for the directions, at least."
Kageaki"Gratefully accepted. But concentrate on going straight rather than thanking me. You are turning already."
Ichijou"A-ah. Haan."

一条「あ、ああ」

一条「その芸術的ってのやめろ！ 　じゃあ、どうしろってんだよ!?」
景明「できれば、飛び越えて下さい」

景明「では、立ち塞がる木々を粉砕しながら直進 するアグレッシブな方針でお願いします」

景明「その『あっち』が既に三〇度弱ずれている ので説得力を見出せません」

一条「あ、ああ」
